description: Unit tests for REQUIRETLS EHLO advertisement and MAIL FROM parsing. EHLO tests: REQUIRETLS present in capability list when is_tls=true, REQUIRETLS absent when is_tls=false. MAIL FROM parser tests: 'MAIL FROM:<user@example.com> REQUIRETLS' extracts requiretls=true; 'MAIL FROM:<user@example.com> SIZE=1000 REQUIRETLS' extracts both params; 'MAIL FROM:<user@example.com>' has requiretls=false; 'MAIL FROM:<user@example.com> REQUIRETLS' on plaintext session is rejected with 530 5.7.0. Use SMTP session test harness already present in crates/smtp/src/.
title: Tests: REQUIRETLS EHLO and MAIL FROM
